name: Tempered hunting knife
description: A hunting knife that has been to a proper smith. It holds an edge through a whole hare and most of a second.
notes: A fine knife; no moves of its own yet, like the hunting knife. Catalogue tier fine (economy doc, knives 25-60 x2.5). Authored for shop stock (mw-ju8.3); not for sale until a shop row stocks it (mw-ju8.5).
